ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "IVFTreatment", FundingComplete__c = TRUE, NOT(ISPICKVAL(FundingCompleteReason__c, "Funding Utilized")), OR( ISCHANGED(TotalMedicationCost__c), AND( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(TotalMedicationCost__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TotalMedicationCost__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not enter a medication cost because funding is complete.
